baselines.notes:
Known caveats at pin 9211b321:
(1) summary.json is always written into --out-dir and embeds wall-clock ms and absolute paths -> recorded as a secondary artifact, expected nondeterministic. (2) The pin's `image` dependency enables avif-native (dav1d via pkg-config); building the pin on Windows without dav1d installed is expected to fail -> typed build_failed outcome, documented blocker, NOT silently patched. (3) --ml is on by default; the embedded restore_v1.onnx is part of the pinned source tree and hashes with the checkout.

baselines.name: v-ice-mainline
baselines.notes: M0 blocker B1 resolution (REVIEW_M0 §6 condition 7; ADR-0014). This is an ADDITIONAL pin, not a replacement: the §2 audit anchor 9211b321 stays above with its honest build_failed record, and 59ab86d1 is its SIBLING (both children of 49f308d9), not its descendant - so the two are different code, which is why both are declared. 59ab86d1 is upstream's own fix for this exact defect and is an ancestor of upstream main; its diff against the merge base is Cargo.toml + Cargo.lock only. Measured before declaring: builds in 4m11s on the recording machine, exposes the same `vice-cli` target and the same `{stem}/{stem}.svg` output contract. Caveats (1) and (3) of the pin above apply unchanged: summary.json carries wall-clock and is a secondary artifact; --ml is on and restore_v1.onnx is part of the pinned tree.

baselines.name: v-ize
baselines.notes:
Known caveats at pin 95a65194:
(1) pin is NOT an ancestor of the mirror's HEAD (lives on a side branch); the fresh clone+detached checkout handles this correctly. (2) known nondeterminism source: centerline.rs components_reconnected() iterates HashMap::into_values() unsorted -> stroke layer order in the SVG can differ between runs when centerline strokes trigger; CLI enables centerline unconditionally. Detected by the repeat comparison, documented, not hidden. (3) vize-cli at pin links the full wgpu stack (215 locked packages); --gpu stays off, CPU path is used.

Known caveats at pin 200897ab:
(1) no dependency manifest exists at the pin (no requirements.txt / pyproject); interpreter deps (numpy, cv2, torch, ...) come from the ambient python and are recorded in env.json only. (2) model checkpoints under models/ are gitignored upstream; 26 of 27 are nevertheless tracked at the pin and only models/corner_rf.joblib (104 MiB) is absent. It is declared as a hash-pinned asset below (B2 resolution); without --asset-root the baseline fails typed asset_root_missing rather than silently reproducing the M0 output_missing outcome. (3) fonts remain out of scope: the smoke corpus contains no text input.
